entities.summary: Captain Silas Talbot was an officer in the Continental Army and Continental Navy during the American Revolutionary War. Talbot is most famous for commanding USS Constitution from 1799 to 1801. Silas Talbot was a member of the Society of the Cincinnati's New York branch.
